purpose: Non-executable governance register through final Phase 4 owner decisions; not a retroactive rewrite of historical event rules.
historicalApplicability: No historical tournament, result, rating or rule reference is reinterpreted by this registry.

sources.S1: First owner implementation prompt, numbered sections; retained in conversation.
sources.S2: Second owner governance reconciliation prompt, numbered sections; retained in conversation.
sources.P1: Owner approval of revised plan and Phase 1-only instruction; retained in conversation.
sources.S3: Owner-confirmed substitution decisions, items 1–8; Phase 1 documentation-only follow-up retained in conversation. Phase 2 requires explicit approval.
sources.S4: Owner Phase 4 implementation approval, sections 1–15, retained in conversation; approved mechanics apply prospectively, without rewriting historical rules.
sources.S5: Owner Phase 4 final governance implementation approval, sections 1–12, retained in conversation. Prospective final registration/self-attendance/automatic lateness/substitute/byes policies; no Phase 5 or configured Neon migration approval.

decisions.decision: Ikh Zasag and its approved addendum govern; subsequent explicit owner decisions supersede only their resolved subjects. Preserve immutable historical versions and published event rules. No consolidated draft is adopted by this registry.

One competitive identity; Steam and Discord both linked and verified before hosting or participation. Either provider may sign in; Discord server membership optional. Verification loss blocks new protected actions, not automatic removal. Corrections require documentation and audit.

Eligible verified players may host, including tournaments that qualify as Grand Battles. Maximum three active hosted tournaments. Hosts may participate but cannot adjudicate their own disputes or invent removal/penalty authority.
Earlier administrator-only creation, mandatory Arena Days, invitation-only access and proposed annual Grand limit no longer govern new Grand classification.

At least 64 distinct verified eligible active participating players. Only active starters count; substitutes count only when occupying eligible active starter positions at the snapshot. No manual assignment or override; no administrator creation/approval prerequisite, Arena Day prerequisite, annual limit or extra invitation requirement.

Recalculate before lock after withdrawal or eligibility change. Permanently record classification after final check-in and roster lock. Later withdrawals/forfeits do not remove status. Classification alone authorizes no extra NR, badge, token or reward.
Preserve optional Arena Day concepts/documentation/history separately from Grand classification. Do not automatically activate special rewards or privileges.

A team must have exactly its required verified eligible self-checked-in active starters. After applicable protections resolve, insufficient starters disqualify the team from starting. Exclude incomplete/disqualified entrants from classification; retain eligible entrants even when their count is not a power of two. This is starting eligibility, not automatic identity revocation or a disciplinary penalty.
Approved formats: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 5v5. Approved entrant capacities: 2,4,8,16,32,64. An entrant is an individual in solo and a team otherwise; entrant count is not active-player count.
3v3 is no longer a deferred-only format. Its competitive activation still requires completed format-specific rules and tests. Preserve historical 3v3 data.

Three active starters, captain, verified eligibility, check-in, roster/settings lock, automatic opponents, confirmations, disputes, authorized ranking and audit. Gate competitive activation until remaining rules and tests are complete.

3v3 permits at most one optional registered substitute. Register before roster lock; activation into an active position requires valid membership and eligibility. Shared substitution timing and authority remain GOV-038.

Floors 1–2 use Open Bracket only. Lowest floor across participating roster members including substitutes controls style eligibility. Host floor counts only when participating. Re-evaluate after roster changes and before lock/draw. Optional Bokh cultural rank remains separate.
Higher-floor unlock thresholds and advanced pairing algorithms remain pending. Preserve concepts/code but gate unsupported competitive operations.

Randomized Single Elimination, auditable reproducible committed draw after eligible roster/settings lock. No manual opponents, seed manipulation or host rerolls; safe idempotent retries. Advance eligible official winners; block affected disputed branches while unrelated branches continue safely.

Ordinary check-in opens scheduled tournament start minus 15 minutes and closes at scheduled start, enforced by server UTC instants. Only a separately scheduled championship final of an already locked Grand Battle uses minus 30 minutes through final start. No automatic final scheduling. Attendance evidence and exceptions remain subject to GOV-041/GOV-042.

One protected lateness incident per eligible Floor 2 player per tournament, maximum 15 minutes from scheduled start. Apply the authenticated automatic workflow in GOV-042. Floor 1 has no equivalent. No misconduct exemption or unapproved disciplinary consequences.

Protection starts at scheduled tournament/match start and ends 15 minutes later, inclusive for timely personal check-in. Do not disqualify an incomplete team while a necessary eligible player can still use protection. Resolve or expire requests before final eligibility and classification; share one incident across contexts.

Five active starters and at most one optional registered substitute. Apply shared roster lock, timing, membership and class-dependent approval rules in GOV-038. No new post-lock substitute or between-map substitution.

Both authorized captains, or both 1v1 competitors, have 15 minutes after submission to confirm/dispute. Agreement triggers server validation; disagreement triggers independent referee review; silence stays pending independent verification, never agreement/cheating/forfeit. Preserve history; claim only substantiated checks.
Earlier mandatory routine administrator result verification is superseded by agreement followed by server validation. Independent review remains required when appropriate.
Ordinary match disputes: 30 minutes after official result notification. Disciplinary appeals: Levels I–II 24 hours; III–V 72 hours after decision notification.

One ordinary appeal per disciplinary decision, different independent authorized reviewer, no self/conflicted adjudication. Escalate if no eligible independent reviewer; preserve evidence and response rights.
Detailed reviewer-assignment hierarchy and exceptional reopening procedure require specification. Do not invent appellate authority or automatic contested-case finality.
Previously approved proposed service targets: ordinary appeal decisions 48 hours; serious disciplinary appeal decisions 7 days. Targets are not automatic rejection deadlines.

Report, preserve evidence, independent review, response, decision, authorized consequence. Referees: rule-authorized I–II; administrators: III–V. Escalate serious misconduct. Allegations are not proven violations; preserve dismissed/insufficient-evidence states. No arbitrary ranking edits or bracket manipulation.
Case details/evidence/decisions restricted to involved parties and authorized reviewers with appropriate limits. Public disciplinary reporting deferred; public outcomes need not expose allegations.

Authorized administrator adjudication plus platform-owner approval; only specifically designated revocable achievement/honor badges. No arbitrary rank-history erasure or historical-result rewrite without separate authorized correction.
Exact revocable badge types remain pending; no execution against undefined types.

Preserve NR formula, nine ranks/emblems and historical transactions. Official result is distinct from final settlement. Finality only after applicable disputes/appeals are satisfied; unresolved result-affecting cases block settlement. Idempotent writes and auditable reversible corrections; no Grand multipliers.

Specify rating-input snapshot/order and effects of authorized corrections on dependent settlements where existing authority is insufficient. Preserve existing formula; do not silently choose new calculation semantics.

No paid entry, player-funded staking, wagering, cash-equivalent rewards, automatic token confiscation or unapproved financial settlement. Preserve economy prototypes without presenting unsupported finance as active. Paid/staked formats need separate approved governance and financial specifications.

When disqualification leaves a non-power-of-two eligible field, Phase 5 will generate fair automatic byes using auditable, reproducible random seeding. Do not generate brackets or implement a seeding algorithm in Phase 4.

Close at capacity or scheduled start minus 15 minutes, whichever comes first; eligible pre-lock withdrawals may reopen places only before the closing deadline. Preserve data, histories, IDs, design and ranking. Do not apply configured database migrations, deploy, push or start Phase 5 without separate approval.
Optional special-event privileges/rewards need separate approval; no invented schedule, qualification claim or countdown. This is not a Grand Battle annual-limit blocker.

Separate opt-in cultural identity/rank; preserve main skill rank, floors, wallet and history. Consensual mode challenges do not authorize regular tournament opponent assignment. No invented progression tiers, decline penalties or economic rates.

Server-side validation/authorization, ownership and conflict checks, transactional locks, idempotent draw/result/rating writes, audit trails, secure private evidence, rate limits, safe errors and no sensitive public logs. Disabled buttons are not authorization.

All team formats allow at most one optional substitute, registered before roster lock. No new substitute after lock; teams locked without one continue without one. Only an already registered eligible substitute may occupy an active slot. Preserve post-lock changes only between completed matches with independent authorized referee approval for ordinary tournaments or authorized administrator approval for locked Grand Battles; never during a match or between BO3 maps.
2v2 permits at most one optional registered substitute, registered before roster lock. Shared substitution timing and authority remain GOV-038.

Non-power-of-two eligible fields may be locked after disqualification without arbitrarily eliminating eligible entrants. Phase 5 owns reproducible random seeding and automatic fair byes; classification counts all eligible active starters.

Ordinary registered players personally confirm attendance through authenticated self-check-in; no referee or captain confirmation. Registration does not imply attendance. Successful check-in is idempotent, timestamped and audited, and represents player confirmation rather than independently verified physical presence.

An eligible Floor 2 player with an unused per-tournament incident personally submits a non-empty reason and completes authenticated check-in no later than scheduled tournament/match start plus 15 minutes. Automatically approve and consume once atomically with attendance/audit. Expired unsuccessful requests do not consume the incident. Prevent concurrent/replayed consumption across tournament/match contexts. No unapproved disciplinary consequences; unsupported match-specific execution remains gated.

Registration closes exactly scheduled tournament start minus 15 minutes, enforced by server time. Reject registration at or after that closing instant; registration and attendance remain separate. Preserve capacity, duplicate and authorization protections.
